updates.summary: Foundayo approved April 1, 2026; current label includes oral PK and CYP3A4 interactions.
Historical Geref approval does not establish approval of current compounded sermorelin. FDA found discontinuation was not for safety or effectiveness.
Confirmed label Vd 103 mL/kg; half-life approximately 2 hours in healthy adults and 1.3 hours in SBS.
Label supports proteolytic metabolism; absence of a conventional phase-II value is not missing measured PK.
FDA states retatrutide is unapproved and cannot be used in compounding under federal law.
Forzinity accelerated approval is specific to Barth syndrome, weight ≥30 kg; confirmatory clinical benefit is required.
